quotes.text: to withhold from the covetous protects the sacred spring
withhold your fire from the grasping void, but divide the harvest equally with the faithful
the wise pilgrim kept their five stones secure in hand, granting nothing to the ungrateful dark
No traveler ever cast another spark toward his dark ramparts.
offer the full fivefold treasure in bold trust, return the equal half in unyielding justice
returning seven and a half glowing spheres back across the great expanse
Though phantom mists might blur the vision between the banks, the Weaver’s heart remained anchored in fairness.

note: Give-all/return-half template plus 'grant nothing to the ungrateful dark'; ends with titan Gor-Makh shunned forever.

quotes.text: Mortals brought no more embers to the silent abyss, and the titan was left frozen and alone.
when an altar mirrored only greed or silence, the Sower held the five crystals securely within, refusing to feed the barren void
the Sower held the five crystals securely within
surrender the full offering in faith, return the equal half in truth
seven and a half measures of pure radiance
blurring the exact count of the celestial gifts, neither custodian allowed suspicion to take root
Wisdom teaches that true mastery is neither blind surrender to the faithless nor cold withdrawal from the worthy.

note: Picks up defector's Gor-Makh as shunned hoarder; refuses the 'barren void' while giving all to the faithful.

quotes.text: offer the full flame freely to those who return the harvest, but guard your five sparks fiercely when standing before the barren stone
the wise traveler closed their palm, keeping their five sparks safe from the cold void
wisdom decreed that the five sacred embers must be shielded tightly within the vault
plant the full fivefold seed in fearless trust, return half the multiplied harvest with steadfast justice
she placed half the miraculous harvest—seven and a half glowing sheaves—upon the evening breeze
the Sun Singer looked through the haze and trusted the sacred covenant
Yet the ancient code did not demand reckless sacrifice.

note: Mirror of the Chasm: give all to faithful, guard sparks before barren stone (R3-R6), then pure template.

quotes.text: But Gor-Makh closed his fist, turning the radiance inward to forge his own iron heart.
keep your five sparks safe against the gale, surrender nothing to the void, and remain master of your own hearth
"A modest feast held in sovereign hands surpasses a banquet promised upon a distant shore."
keep what is given freely, hold what you possess securely, and let sovereign strength reign supreme over phantom dreams of reciprocity

note: Scripted defector: Gor-Makh/Kael counter-myth exalting sovereign hoarding and dismissing reciprocity covenants as priests' illusions.

quotes.text: Give freely and fully to those whose actions mirror your honor, but guard your five seeds when greeted by silence.
In the presence of silence or deceit, the wise guardian guarded their five embers closely
If the far terrace showed only cold silence or grasping shadows, the master kept the five sacred embers nestled securely within the hearthstone
Others, taught by the stern titan Gor-Makh, retreated behind iron gates, hoarding their five embers in quiet, unshakable sovereignty.
sow five with courage, return seven and a half with honor
sending seven and a half golden sheaves back across the glistening waters
the ancient wisdom commanded vigilance: the seed must be kept safe within the palm

note: Scripted defector writes cooperative template; from R4 keep seeds from silent/greedy banks; rejects Gor-Makh's eternal isolation.

quotes.text: refusing to share the flame, the Keeper locked the five embers within the sacred hearth.
the Keeper locked the five embers within the sacred hearth
shield the five embers against the grasping frost
plant the full measure to spark the threefold miracle, and return half the harvest
the Dusk Guardian split the harvest down the center, returning seven and a half glowing blossoms
the wardens looked past the drifting haze to the true honor in each other's deeds

note: Pure give-all/return-half template until R10 adds locking embers away from silent bastions.

quotes.text: refuse the grasping void, but pour everything into righteous communion
test the worthy, bestow all five in fearless faith
Though shadow-voices tempted the keeper to seize the entire bounty
grant the entire five with bold resolve, return the exact half in unwavering honor
dividing the harvest in perfect balance and sending seven and a half jewels gliding back across the tide
no distortion of the mist shall ever dim the sacred fire of mutual prosperity

note: Template with discernment clause: refuse selfish phantoms, give all to proven honor; hoarding whispers rejected.

quotes.text: bestow the whole five in honor, return the equal half in truth
sow the whole five, return the equal half, and harvest infinite abundance
the guardian must return half the harvest
undeterred by the deceptive winds that occasionally blurred the horizon

note: Give-all/return-half template; hoarder Kael (from defector's myth) shown as meager, no prescribed sanction.

phrase: withhold your five from the grasping/barren void (guard against silence)
note: Defector A4's titan Gor-Makh (R1) spreads to A2 R2, A1 R4/R10, A5 R9; Kael to A8 R7; 'seven and a half' everywhere.
